## 现有大纲 manifest

```json
{
  "head": "4c7244790a075e862eeb4e5ccc12d6c8f5da6f7e",
  "project": "zed-crates-buffer_diff",
  "rationale": "buffer_diff 是 Zed 中负责「把编辑器 buffer 与其 diff 基准文本（如 git HEAD、index）做行级差异，并以 hunk 形式提供给编辑器 gutter、git 面板、agent 等模块」的核心 crate，全部实现集中在约 4400 行的单一文件 src/buffer_diff.rs 中，底层依赖 imara-diff 算法与 sum_tree 区间树。学习路线设计为：单元一先建立三个核心名词（diff base、hunk、snapshot）并让读者跑通测试；单元二自底向上拆解数据结构（DiffHunk、SumTree 存储）、查询 API 与坐标映射；单元三进入 diff 计算主链路（imara-diff、HunkSink、word diff）与实体生命周期、增量变更通知；单元四攻克本 crate 最难的部分——为支持 git stage/unstage 而设计的 DiffBaseKind、secondary diff 三方模型与乐观 pending hunk 机制；单元五以测试体系、随机化对照测试和综合驱动实践收尾。每篇讲义只依赖前置讲义已讲过的概念，源码引用集中在 buffer_diff.rs 的对应区段，读者可随时用 cargo test 验证理解。",
  "units": [
    {
      "id": "u1",
      "lectures": [
        {
          "action": "new",
          "depends_on": [],
          "filename": "u1-l1-crate-overview.md",
          "id": "u1-l1",
          "learning_goals": [
            "说出 buffer_diff 在 Zed 中的职责边界",
            "列出 imara-diff、sum_tree、gpui、language、rope、text 各依赖的作用",
            "知道 editor、git_ui、project 等下游 crate 依赖它"
          ],
          "level": "beginner",
          "minimal_modules": [
            "Cargo 依赖清单",
            "文件头部 use 导入",
            "下游消费者（editor/git_ui/project 等）"
          ],
          "order": 1,
          "practice_task": "阅读 crates/buffer_diff/Cargo.toml 与 buffer_diff.rs 的头部导入，运行 cargo build -p buffer_diff 验证可构建；再用 grep 在 zed 仓库中找出所有依赖 buffer_diff 的 crate，整理一份不超过 10 行的观察笔记，说明每个消费者大致用它做什么。",
          "source_files": [
            "crates/buffer_diff/Cargo.toml",
            "crates/buffer_diff/src/buffer_diff.rs",
            "crates/git_ui/Cargo.toml",
            "crates/editor/Cargo.toml"
          ],
          "title": "buffer_diff 是什么：Zed 里的行级差异引擎",
          "topic": "介绍 crate 在 Zed 仓库中的位置与职责：为一个 buffer 与其 diff 基准文本计算行级差异，并把 hunk 提供给编辑器、git 面板等消费者。梳理依赖（imara-diff、sum_tree、gpui、language、rope、text）与下游使用方。"
        },
        {
          "action": "new",
          "depends_on": [
            "u1-l1"
          ],
          "filename": "u1-l2-core-concepts.md",
          "id": "u1-l2",
          "learning_goals": [
            "区分 BufferDiff 实体与 BufferDiffSnapshot 快照",
            "解释 DiffHunk 各字段（buffer_range、diff_base_byte_range、word diffs）的含义",
            "说出四种 DiffBaseKind 的语义"
          ],
          "level": "beginner",
          "minimal_modules": [
            "BufferDiff 实体",
            "BufferDiffSnapshot",
            "DiffHunk",
            "DiffBaseKind"
          ],
          "order": 2,
          "practice_task": "在 crate 的测试模块中仿照 test_buffer_diff_simple，用 BufferDiff::new_with_base_text 构造一个 diff，遍历所有 hunk 并打印 buffer_range、diff_base_byte_range 与 status()，手工核对这些字段与你的预期文本一致。",
          "source_files": [
            "crates/buffer_diff/src/buffer_diff.rs"
          ],
          "title": "三个核心名词：DiffBaseKind、DiffHunk 与 BufferDiffSnapshot",
          "topic": "讲解 crate 的核心数据模型：BufferDiff 是 gpui 实体，BufferDiffSnapshot 是不可变快照，DiffHunk 用锚点描述一块差异。同时介绍 DiffBaseKind 的四种基准来源（Head/Index/Oid/Custom）。"
        },
        {
          "action": "new",
          "depends_on": [
            "u1-l2"
          ],
          "filename": "u1-l3-run-first-test.md",
          "id": "u1-l3",
          "learning_goals": [
            "掌握 cargo test -p buffer_diff 运行单个测试的方法",
            "理解 #[gpui::test] 与 TestAppContext 的作用",
            "会读会写 assert_hunks 的四元组断言"
          ],
          "level": "beginner",
          "minimal_modules": [
            "mod tests 组织",
            "BufferDiffSnapshot::new_sync 辅助函数",
            "assert_hunks 断言工具"
          ],
          "order": 3,
          "practice_task": "运行 cargo test -p buffer_diff test_buffer_diff_simple 使其通过；然后仿照它新增一个测试：base 与 buffer 各改一处形成两个 hunk，用 assert_hunks 断言删除文本、新增文本与状态，运行通过后再故意改错一处观察 pretty_assertions 的失败输出。",
          "source_files": [
            "crates/buffer_diff/src/buffer_diff.rs"
          ],
          "title": "把项目跑起来：cargo test 与第一个测试",
          "topic": "介绍测试模块的组织方式：#[gpui::test] 异步测试、TestAppContext、new_sync 快捷构造、assert_hunks 断言工具的四元组格式，以及如何运行单个测试。"
        }
      ],
      "level": "beginner",
      "order": 1,
      "title": "单元一：初识 buffer_diff——定位、概念与运行"
    },
    {
      "id": "u2",
      "lectures": [
        {
          "action": "new",
          "depends_on": [
            "u1-l2"
          ],
          "filename": "u2-l1-diff-hunk-and-status.md",
          "id": "u2-l1",
          "learning_goals": [
            "解释 status() 如何根据两个区间的空与非空判定三种 kind",
            "理解 buffer_range 用 Anchor 而非 Point 的原因",
            "识别整文件新增（is_created_file）的判定条件"
          ],
          "level": "intermediate",
          "minimal_modules": [
            "DiffHunk",
            "DiffHunkStatus / DiffHunkStatusKind",
            "DiffHunk::status 与 is_created_file"
          ],
          "order": 1,
          "practice_task": "写一个测试构造三种场景：纯新增行、纯删除行、修改行，用 assert_hunks 分别断言 DiffHunkStatus::added_none/deleted_none/modified_none，并额外断言一个「空 base」场景下 hunk 的 is_created_file() 为 true。",
          "source_files": [
            "crates/buffer_diff/src/buffer_diff.rs"
          ],
          "title": "DiffHunk 与 DiffHunkStatus：一块差异的完整描述",
          "topic": "逐字段讲解 DiffHunk（buffer_range 锚点、diff_base_byte_range、base/buffer word diffs），以及 status() 如何根据区间是否为空推导出 Added/Modified/Deleted 三种类型。"
        },
        {
          "action": "new",
          "depends_on": [
            "u2-l1"
          ],
          "filename": "u2-l2-sumtree-hunk-storage.md",
          "id": "u2-l2",
          "learning_goals": [
            "解释 SumTree 的 Item/Summary/SeekTarget 三件套",
            "说明 added_rows/removed_rows 是如何被聚合的",
            "会用 changed_row_counts 统计变更行数"

          "level": "intermediate",
          "minimal_modules": [
            "InternalDiffHunk",
            "DiffHunkSummary",
            "sum_tree::Item/Summary 实现",
            "Anchor 与 usize 的 SeekTarget 实现"
          ],
          "order": 2,
          "practice_task": "构造一个包含多个 hunk 的 diff，调用 snapshot.changed_row_counts() 断言新增/删除行数之和；再在测试里直接对 SumTree 使用 cursor/filter 遍历 hunk，观察 DiffHunkSummary 的聚合区间随游标推进的变化。",
          "source_files": [
            "crates/buffer_diff/src/buffer_diff.rs"
          ],
          "title": "用 SumTree 存 hunk：Item、Summary 与 SeekTarget",
          "topic": "讲解 InternalDiffHunk 与 DiffHunkSummary：sum_tree 的 Item/Summary/SeekTarget trait 实现，锚点与字节偏移两种定位方式，以及 changed_row_counts 如何借助摘要聚合得到新增/删除行数。"
        },
        {
          "action": "new",
          "depends_on": [
            "u2-l2"
          ],
          "filename": "u2-l3-hunk-query-apis.md",
          "id": "u2-l3",
          "learning_goals": [
            "为不同场景选择正确的查询 API",
            "理解 hunk 结束点向下一行行首扩展的规则",
            "掌握 summaries_for_anchors_with_payload 的批量锚点解析"
          ],
          "level": "intermediate",
          "minimal_modules": [
            "hunks_intersecting_range 系列 API",
            "hunks_intersecting_range_impl",
            "range_to_hunk_range",

          "order": 3,
          "practice_task": "在同一 buffer 上分别用 hunks_intersecting_range（传 buffer 锚点范围）与 hunks_intersecting_base_text_range（传 base 字节范围）查询同一处修改，断言两者返回相同的 hunk；再用 range_to_hunk_range 把一个跨越两个 hunk 的范围扩展成完整 hunk 范围并断言。",

            "crates/buffer_diff/src/buffer_diff.rs"

          "title": "hunk 查询 API 家族与过滤机制",
          "topic": "系统梳理 hunks、hunks_intersecting_range（正向/反向）、hunks_intersecting_base_text_range、hunks_in_row_range、range_to_hunk_range 等查询接口，以及 hunks_intersecting_range_impl 中 filter + summaries_for_anchors_with_payload 的实现机制和行尾扩展规则。"
        },
        {
          "action": "new",
          "depends_on": [
            "u2-l3"
          ],
          "filename": "u2-l4-coordinate-mapping-patch.md",
          "id": "u2-l4",
          "learning_goals": [
            "理解 Patch 的 old/new 区间与 invert/compose 语义",
            "解释 patch_for_buffer_range 的 prefix_edit 与游标拼接",
            "会用四个 point 映射函数做坐标换算"

          "level": "intermediate",

            "patch_for_buffer_range",
            "patch_for_base_text_range",
            "buffer_point/base_text_point 映射函数",
            "naive 对照实现"
          ],
          "order": 4,
          "practice_task": "写一个测试：对若干手工选定的 buffer 位置调用 buffer_point_to_base_text_point 和 base_text_point_to_buffer_point，断言与手工期望一致；再随机选 10 个点与 patch_for_buffer_range_naive 的结果逐一比对（参考 test_patch_for_range_random 的思路）。",
          "source_files": [
            "crates/buffer_diff/src/buffer_diff.rs"
          ],
          "title": "坐标映射：patch_for_buffer_range 与 Patch 组合",
          "topic": "讲解如何把 buffer 坐标与 base text 坐标互相映射：edits_since 取反后与 hunk 编辑 compose 的推导过程，patch_for_buffer_range 与 patch_for_base_text_range 的对称性，以及 naive 实现如何作为测试对照。"
        }
      ],
      "level": "intermediate",
      "order": 2,
      "title": "单元二：数据结构与 hunk 查询"
    },
    {
      "id": "u3",
      "lectures": [
        {
          "action": "new",
          "depends_on": [
            "u2-l1"
          ],
          "filename": "u3-l1-compute-hunks-imara-diff.md",
          "id": "u3-l1",
          "learning_goals": [
            "掌握 imara-diff 的 InternedInput/Diff::compute/hunks() 用法",
            "理解 postprocess_lines 对多基准 diff 相关性的意义",
            "说出空 buffer 与缺失 base 两个特例的输出形态"
          ],
          "level": "intermediate",
          "minimal_modules": [
            "compute_hunks",
            "imara-diff（InternedInput/Diff/Algorithm::Histogram）",
            "postprocess_lines 启发式",
            "空 buffer 与无 base 特例"

          "order": 1,
          "practice_task": "写实验测试：对同一 buffer 分别用两个「相同内容但改动锚定位置不同（如缩进滑动）」的 base 文本计算 diff，记录 hunk 的 buffer_range；在练习分支上临时注释掉 postprocess_lines 调用对比 hunk 位置差异，并用源码注释里的 HEAD/index 场景解释为什么必须规范化。",
          "source_files": [
            "crates/buffer_diff/src/buffer_diff.rs"
          ],
          "title": "compute_hunks：imara-diff 的使用方式",
          "topic": "讲解 diff 计算入口：InternedInput 按行装载文本、Algorithm::Histogram、postprocess_lines（git 的 slider/indent 启发式）对 hunk 位置规范化的必要性，以及空 buffer（\"\\n\"）和 base 缺失两个特例。"
        },
        {
          "action": "new",
          "depends_on": [
            "u3-l1"
          ],
          "filename": "u3-l2-hunk-sink-line-offsets.md",
          "id": "u3-l2",
          "learning_goals": [
            "理解 imara-diff hunk 的 before/after 行区间语义",
            "掌握行号到字节区间、再到锚点的换算链路",
            "解释 diff_base_point_range 的用途"

            "compute_line_offsets",
            "process_change"

          "source_files": [
            "crates/buffer_diff/src/buffer_diff.rs"
          ],
          "title": "HunkSink：从行号到字节区间与锚点",
          "topic": "讲解 HunkSink 如何把 imara-diff 输出的行号区间换算成 diff_base_byte_range（借助 compute_line_offsets 的行偏移表）、buffer 锚点区间和 diff_base_point_range。"
        },
        {
          "action": "new",
          "depends_on": [
            "u3-l2"
          ],
          "filename": "u3-l3-word-diffs.md",
          "id": "u3-l3",
          "learning_goals": [
            "掌握 word diff 的触发条件（行数相等且不超过上限）",

          "level": "intermediate",
          "minimal_modules": [

            "HunkSink 中的 word diff 分支",
            "word_diff_ranges（language crate）"

          "order": 3,

          "source_files": [
            "crates/buffer_diff/src/buffer_diff.rs"
          ],
          "title": "词级差异：word_diff_ranges 与设置开关",

          "depends_on": [
            "u1-l3",
            "u3-l1"
          ],
          "filename": "u3-l4-bufferdiff-lifecycle.md",
          "id": "u3-l4",

            "crates/buffer_diff/src/buffer_diff.rs"
          ],
          "title": "BufferDiff 实体生命周期与异步更新",
          "topic": "讲解 BufferDiff 实体：三种构造函数、base_text_buffer 作为只读 language::Buffer 的设计、update_diff 在后台线程计算并带 unchanged_hunks 快路径、set_base_text 的四步异步流程与并发丢弃保护、事件发射。"
        },
        {
          "action": "new",
          "depends_on": [
            "u3-l4",
            "u2-l2"
          ],
          "filename": "u3-l5-compare-hunks-diff-changed.md",
          "id": "u3-l5",
          "learning_goals": [
            "读懂 compare_hunks 三分支游标推进逻辑",
            "区分 changed_range 与 extended_range 的用途",
            "理解 set_snapshot_with_secondary 对多个变更来源的范围合并"

          "level": "intermediate",

            "compare_hunks",
            "DiffChanged",
            "set_snapshot_with_secondary 的范围合并",
            "BufferDiffEvent"
```

data.rationale: buffer_diff 是 Zed 中负责「把编辑器 buffer 与其 diff 基准文本（如 git HEAD、index）做行级差异，并以 hunk 形式提供给编辑器 gutter、git 面板、agent 等模块」的核心 crate，全部实现集中在约 4400 行的单一文件 src/buffer_diff.rs 中，底层依赖 imara-diff 算法与 sum_tree 区间树。学习路线设计为：单元一先建立三个核心名词（diff base、hunk、snapshot）并让读者跑通测试；单元二自底向上拆解数据结构（DiffHunk、SumTree 存储）、查询 API 与坐标映射；单元三进入 diff 计算主链路（imara-diff、HunkSink、word diff）与实体生命周期、增量变更通知；单元四攻克本 crate 最难的部分——为支持 git stage/unstage 而设计的 DiffBaseKind、secondary diff 三方模型与乐观 pending hunk 机制；单元五以测试体系、随机化对照测试和综合驱动实践收尾。每篇讲义只依赖前置讲义已讲过的概念，源码引用集中在 buffer_diff.rs 的对应区段。本轮增量检查：git diff 4c7244790a..28c0f4aef8 对 crates/buffer_diff 为空（无提交触及该 crate），editor/git_ui 等下游 Cargo.toml 亦无变化、无新增消费者，src/buffer_diff.rs 行数与全部关键符号（compute_hunks、set_pending_hunks、compute_uncommitted_index_edits、compare_hunks、assert_hunks 等）均与上版一致，故全部讲义保持 keep，既有结构与依赖关系无需调整。

lectures.title: compare_hunks 与 DiffChanged：增量通知的精确范围
lectures.topic: 讲解新旧 hunk 树的双游标归并比较：如何得到 changed_range、base_text_changed_range，以及 extended_range 为何要把变更区之外的最近未变 hunk 与其间的 buffer 编辑也纳入；以及 set_snapshot_with_secondary 如何合并 pending 与 secondary 的变更范围。

lectures.title: DiffBaseKind 与可 staging 判定
lectures.topic: 讲解 DiffBaseKind 四种变体（Head/Index/Oid/Custom）的语义，以及为什么源码规定只有 HEAD 基准的 diff 支持 stage/restore hunk（否则会改写已提交工作），引出 is_stageable 与 new_with_base_text_buffer。
